name: Blend between camera poses
body: Every change of rig settings or shot blends from the pose on screen to the new one over the volume's `blend` seconds (smoothstep), tracking the moving target instead of freezing the start pose. A blend of 0 is a cut. Position and field of view blend linearly; direction blends by normalised lerp so there is no roll.

comments.text: Done: smooth-step blend of the live pose, 0 is a cut, exit_blend for leaving (D-138). The camera room test checks no frame moves the lens over 0.9 m.

acceptance_criteria: No frame jumps by more than the blend allows
A cut (blend 0) lands on the new pose the same frame
A test measures per-frame movement across a blend
